decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to use the combo of Transmogrify and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to cheat big creatures onto the battlefield quickly. The deck includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to deal with threats. The companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, provides additional mana acceleration. The deck also includes cards like Esika's Chariot and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to generate tokens and support the main combo strategy. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with green devotion cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Oath of Nissa, while utilizing creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to apply pressure on opponents. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provides additional ramp and card draw, while Karn, the Great Creator offers utility and disruption. Storm the Festival allows for more creatures to be searched for and played, ensuring a steady stream of threats. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large creatures and powerful spells, taking advantage of the mana acceleration provided by the devotion to green theme.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain control over the game by using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Roast and Fading Hope, while using counterspells like Spell Pierce to disrupt opponents' plays. Card draw spells like Opt and Treasure Cruise help to maintain card advantage, while powerful creatures like Crackling Drake provide a win condition. The deck also utilizes lands like Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City for additional control options and mana fixing.

This deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining board presence with creatures and removal spells. The deck also includes a companion (Yorion, Sky Nomad) to provide additional value and flexibility. With strong enchantments like Emeria's Call and Ossification, powerful creatures like Elesh Norn, and versatile cards like Skyclave Apparition, Mono White Control aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure the win through a combination of control and aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, to cast powerful green creatures and spells. The deck focuses on generating green mana devotion with cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Elvish Mystic to fuel cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also includes ways to search for key cards with Oath of Nissa and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner, as well as disruptive elements with Karn, the Great Creator.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up your mana using cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful green spells. The deck focuses on utilizing green devotion cards and powerful creatures like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn to overwhelm your opponent with aggression. Cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional support and card advantage. The deck has a strong emphasis on generating mana and casting impactful green spells to dominate the battlefield.

This deck focuses on rapidly casting spells to trigger the Arclight Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard to the battlefield. With a mix of cheap spells, card draw, and graveyard manipulation, the deck aims to quickly bring out multiple Phoenixes to overwhelm the opponent. The use of Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass provides additional card advantage and potential for explosive turns. The inclusion of counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal like Lightning Axe helps to protect the Phoenixes and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and direct damage to control the board and pressure the opponent. By combining cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven, the deck can create a loop of sacrificing creatures to deal damage and generate value. Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push offer removal options, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana acceleration. The deck also includes aggressive threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bloodtithe Harvester to close out games quickly. The key strategy is to maintain board presence through sacrificing and dealing damage until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to swarm the board with low-cost creatures like Ornithopter and Thraben Inspector, then pump them up with cards like Venerated Loxodon and Resolute Reinforcements to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck also utilizes some removal spells like Giant Killer and Gleeful Demolition to deal with opposing threats, while also having access to Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional mana ramp. The aggressive strategy of this deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and finish the game swiftly.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to consistently tutor for powerful creatures and lockdown enchantments. By combining control elements with a toolbox of high-impact threats and disruptive cards, the goal is to slow down the opponent's game plan while setting up a strong board state. The inclusion of Fires of Invention allows for explosive turns, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding provide additional value and disruption. With a strong mana base and a variety of powerful threats, the deck aims to control the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with its versatile creatures and enchantments.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card draw while utilizing Yorion as a companion for additional value. The deck includes powerful control cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Supreme Verdict, and Dovin's Veto, alongside efficient card draw with Omen of the Sea and Memory Deluge. Shark Typhoon provides a win condition while March of Otherworldly Light and Make Disappear offer additional disruption. The deck also includes utility lands like Castle Ardenvale and Field of Ruin for added flexibility in dealing with threats.

The main concept of this deck is to use Fires of Invention to play powerful control cards for free and take advantage of the Colossus Hammer and Sigarda's Aid combo to quickly ramp up damage and overwhelm the opponent. The deck focuses on aggressive plays with cards like Legion Loyalist and Rundvelt Hordemaster, while also utilizing Open the Armory to search for key pieces of the combo. With a mix of removal, creatures, and equipment, the deck aims to control the board while setting up for lethal attacks.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on relentless aggression and disruption. It utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to control the board while deploying threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Misery's Shadow to close out games. By combining efficient removal with powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and win through a combination of early pressure and late-game threats.
